propositions: rebar truncates DC comments at compile-time constant 32767, ignoring the admin-configurable jira.text.field.character.limit property, causing silent data loss when an administrator raises or removes the limit
the hardcoded constant is correct for stock Jira 7.0+ instances (default is 32767) but wrong for configured instances where the limit has been raised to a higher value or set to 0 (unlimited)
comments longer than the hardcoded 32767 but shorter than the instance's configured limit are silently truncated, creating permanent divergence between local and remote comment bodies
the DC comment ceiling must be made configurable via ReconcilerConfig, defaulting to 32767, with a documented provenance citation to jira.text.field.character.limit and JRASERVER-28519
the comment sanitizer must not depend on the description fitter to prevent future description-fitter changes from inadvertently retargeting comment truncation logic
